page_summary: The World Bank survey highlights disparities in cybersecurity practices between high-income and low- & middle-income ports. Key findings include that 83% of high-income ports report incidents to a response team, compared to 56% of low- & middle-income ports. Additionally, 79% of high-income ports have conducted cybersecurity risk assessments in the past 24 months, while only 56% of low- & middle-income ports have done so. Furthermore, 84% of high-income ports provide regular cybersecurity training, in contrast to 49% of low- & middle-income ports.
